args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and began failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`), and the service is now healthy (error rate 0.002).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — this was a rollback to a previously healthy production release.
